bio: Youngs Family (1907) gives Rev. Christopher Yonges b. England about 1545, d. Southwold 14 June 1626, buried in the chancel under a brass tablet. His wife was **Margaret**, buried 5 Nov 1630, whose will of 27 Oct 1630 names her six children John, Joseph, Christopher, Mary, Margaret and Martha ([R4-S1]). The tree's birth of 21 Nov 1575 and wife Johanna Horne are not supported, and the book names no father. He is in any case not an ancestor of John's on present evidence (see Rev. John Youngs).

conflicts.assessment: The tree is unsupported; Youngs 1907 gives Margaret.
